title: PaymentLineDetail

ItemRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the Item. When a line lacks an ItemRef it will be treated as "documentation" and the Amount will be ignored.

ServiceDate.description: Product: ALL Description: Date when the service is performed.

ClassRef.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to the Class for the line item.

Balance.description: Product: ALL Description: Indicates the unpaid amount of the transaction after this payment is applied.[br /]Cannot be written to QuickBooks.

HomeBalance.description: Product: ALL Description: Indicates the unpaid amount of the transaction after this payment is applied in home currency. It is visible only for companies which have multicurrency enabled[br /] Cannot be written to Quickbooks.

Discount.description: Product: ALL Description: Reference to a Discount item and its properties that this line can overwrite.

PaymentLineEx.description: Product: ALL Description: Internal use only: extension place holder for PaymentDetail

description: Product: ALL Description: Payment detail for a transaction line.
